title: Over a dozen chatbot harm & suicide cases in California against OpenAI / ChatGPT have been consolidated into one big

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: How can we balance AI's potential with the real risks it poses to human well-being?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Current models can generate harmful content, but guardrails like content filters and alignment training are improving.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Even with filters, vulnerable users may still be exposed to triggering material, risking harm or even suicide.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Engineers are developing real-time sentiment analysis and safer defaults to mitigate such risks.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: A future where AI is a compassionate co-pilot, offering support without judgment or harm.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future of AI depends on aligning technical progress with deep ethical responsibility.

video_cue: A courtroom scene with AI interfaces projected on walls, showing legal debates over AI accountability.
